description: Verify whether a supplement is safe to recommend to a user given their medications and current supplements. Runs the same interaction check as /med-check plus pathway analysis on the full stack including the new supplement. Returns interaction_found, agent_summary, confidence, severity, timing_recommendation, citation, full_interactions, and pathway_analysis. Use whenever an AI agent is about to suggest a supplement and needs a determination of whether any known interactions were found in Elthio's 1,793-rule database.

context.description: Optional — why the user wants this supplement (stored for audit only).

supplement.description: Supplement the agent wants to recommend. e.g. 'Omega-3 Fish Oil 1000mg'

supplements_already_taking.description: Supplements the user already takes (excluding the one being recommended).

name: verify_supplement_recommendation
